scope: Representation diagnosis only; no additional policy training or policy evaluation run.
test_disclosure: The same stream100 teacher-support observations were already used in formal teacher-supported scoring. These fitted analysis heads are a post-hoc diagnosis, not new independent validation.
labels: Legacy PublicReceiptBinder reconstructs answered context-index*4+raw solely from public history, processing receipt before this tick's cue. Labels enter only the temporary analysis heads and are never written back to policy.
selection: Successful matched FINISH receipt rows, excluding NEW/REPLACE in that same slot on the current tick; both jobs remain represented.

ridge.standardization: Training-only column mean and population std; std<1e-12 replaced by 1.
ridge.objective: sum squared residuals + lambda * squared weights (excluding bias)

feature_definitions.public28: Current public features of the answered job only.
feature_definitions.trained_z32_public28: Actual trained public-only encoder state after consuming the receipt, concatenated with that job's current public28.
feature_definitions.untrained_z32_public28: Encoder from fixed new_native(seed) initialization, frozen, driven by the same public history, plus public28.
feature_definitions.legacy_raw_h192_public28: Frozen original executor.core driven by unmodified raw56, zero initial h, plus the answered job public28. Extra representation reference; NOT the main policy's actual translated-executor state.
